market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to slightly lower over 1-3 months. Fourth RBA hike risk and housing correction fears cap upside. Banks provide relative support but face credit overhang. Oil strength supports energy. Bathla fallout may trigger construction sector sell-off.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. Goldman's lower-return warning and stalling GDP suggest modest ASX gains. Iron ore rebalancing and energy transition costs create sector rotation. Housing correction may deepen, pressuring financials. Quality large caps (BHP, CSL, CBA) outperform on dividend yield.
